# Dedicated forward proxy for the legacy origin on node2.
visible_hostname node1-forward-proxy

acl legacy_origin dst 10.100.98.11/32
acl approved_http_port port 8081
acl connect_method method CONNECT

http_access deny all

cache deny all
access_log daemon:/var/log/squid/access.log squid

coredump_dir /var/spool/squid
